Priya (Sales Eng): FYI EdgeHealth POC ask: sustained 3k QPS p50~100ms, p95<250ms, burst to 12k QPS for ~120s. Customer requires CloudHSM + IP allowlist + 1yr audit logs. Need runbook + cost ballpark + blockers.

Noah (AE): Cost-sensitive. Model = redwood-13b-q8, avg prompt 40t, response 50t. Mostly chat.

Sam (SRE): Proposal: Dedicated pool w/ continuous batching. Baseline 2 A100-80 equiv for steady 3k; pre-warm 3 extra GPUs for burst. Runbook: 10m steady @3k -> 2m burst @12k -> 10m cooldown. Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, queue depth, KMS latency.

Lina (Solutions): Security: confirm CloudHSM vendor (AWS) and rotation policy <=30d or exception. HSM adds ~10ms per request to latency—include in SLO.

Priya (Sales Eng): Sample safe load snippet we recommend (k6 harness):
```bash
k6 run --vus 6000 --duration 2m script.js # controlled burst
```

infra-bot: scheduled deploy -> dedicated-edge-03 @2026-04-05T18:00:00Z.

Noah (AE): Billing Q: bursts billed as per-GPU-minute metered above commit. Rough incremental: +3 GPUs * 2min * burst_rate_per_gpu_min. I'll make a slide with numbers.

Sam (SRE): Pre-run smoke (internal): steady 3k w/ caching: p50 92ms, p95 220ms, p99 430ms. Burst synthetic saw spikes ~1.1s due to kernel cold-starts. Mitigations: kernel pre-warm, lower autoscale threshold.

Priya (Sales Eng): Action items: (1) ask customer for token-length CSV, (2) deliver runbook + cost + security checklist EOD tomorrow. Ping here when CSV received. :thumbsup:
